mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates extreme monetary accommodation, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly declines in housing starts and retail sales exceeding 1% indicate a broad-based consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline >1% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline >1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-stage recession, a decline in industrial production signals worsening economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In early-stage recession periods, INDPRO decline is not associated with negative SPX 20-day returns (returns positive in >60% of such periods).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month CPI increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points indicates accelerating inflation, prompting potential monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises >0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls above 145,000 thousand indicate a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 145,000 thousand.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a quarterly GDP decline from the prior quarter signals an economic slowdown, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, a GDPC1 decline from prior quarter is not associated with negative SPX 5-day returns (returns positive in >60% of such periods).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly decline in industrial production and quarterly decline in GDP indicate severe economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines from prior month and GDPC1 declines from prior quarter
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines from prior month and GDPC1 declines from prior quarter.
